instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Zest both oranges, taking only the orange part of the peel.
Beat the softened butter and sugar together in a large bowl for about 2 minutes, until it's creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time. Scrape down the bowl after each one.
Mix in the baking powder, salt and vanilla.
Add the flour in 3 parts, alternating with the milk in 2 parts, stirring gently after each. Stop as soon as there are no dry streaks. Any longer and the muffins come out tough.
Fold in the cranberries and orange zest.
Scoop the batter into the cups, filling each nearly to the top.
Bake for 28 to 30 minutes, until the tops are light golden and a toothpick in the center of a muffin comes out clean.
Loosen the edges, leave the muffins in the tin for 5 minutes, then move them to a rack to cool.
Keep the cooled muffins in an airtight container for up to 3 days. To freeze, wrap them well and freeze for up to 3 months. Microwave a frozen muffin on high for about 30 seconds.
method_notes: The Redhead Baker's cranberry orange muffins are the lead (butter, sugar, dried cranberries, zest of 2 oranges, 375°F). It has no ratings, and Add a Pinch, the best known version, blocked fetching. Food Network and Kristine's Kitchen agree on the zest, milk and about 12 muffins; cranberries are 1 1/2 cups rather than the lead's 2 cups. Storage notes come from Kristine's Kitchen and the lead.
